title: Low-Rank Adaptation for Critic Learning in Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.18978v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scaling critic capacity is a promising direction for improving off-policy reinforcement learning (RL). However, recent work shows that larger critics are prone to overfitting and instability in replay-based bootstrapped training. In this paper, we propose using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a structural regularizer for critic learning from scratch. Our approach freezes randomly initialized base matrices and optimizes only the corresponding low-rank adapters, thereby constraining the learned weight changes to low-rank residuals. translated_title: 离策略强化学习中评论家学习的低秩适应方法
translated_abstract: 扩大评论家（critic）网络的容量是改进离策略强化学习（RL）的一个有前景的方向。然而，近期研究表明，更大的评论家在基于经验回放的自举训练中容易出现过拟合和不稳定问题。本文提出使用低秩适应（LoRA）作为从头训练评论家的结构化正则化手段。我们的方法冻结随机初始化的基础矩阵，仅优化对应的低秩适配器，从而将学习到的权重变化约束在低秩残差范围内。我们在基于状态的连续控制任务上评估了该方法，包括在DMC-Hard上使用SAC配合SimbaV2以及BRC，在IsaacLab上使用FastTD3及其SimbaV2变体。实验结果表明，LoRA降低了训练过程中的评论家损失，并提升了整体策略性能，在大多数任务上取得了最佳或具有竞争力的结果。大量实验证明，我们的低秩更新为评论家学习提供了一种简单而有效的正则化形式。
tldr: 本文提出将低秩适应（LoRA）作为结构化正则化器应用于强化学习评论家训练，通过冻结随机基矩阵、仅优化低秩适配器来约束权重更新，有效缓解了大容量评论家的过拟合与不稳定问题，并在多个连续控制基准上提升了策略性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a structural regularizer for RL critic learning, freezing randomly initialized base matrices and training only low-rank adapters to constrain weight updates, which mitigates overfitting and instability of larger critics and improves policy performance across continuous-control benchmarks.
